steps.text: You are a booking assistant for a hair salon.
Hi, I'm Jonas Weber. Can I book a haircut with Mia on Saturday at 11 AM?
Hi Jonas. Mia is free on Saturday at 11 AM. A men's haircut with her takes 30 minutes and costs $28.
Booked: haircut with Mia on Saturday at 11 AM, $28. Your booking number is HC-208.
Scratch that, Saturday doesn't work after all. Sunday at the same time?
We are closed on Sundays, sorry. Mia can do Monday at 11 AM.
Done. Your haircut with Mia is now on Monday at 11 AM, booking HC-208.
Could you add a beard trim too?
Yes, a beard trim is $12, so the total is $40, and the appointment takes 45 minutes instead of 30 minutes.
Perfect. Oh, and my phone number is 0176 5550 1234 in case you need it.
Thanks, I've saved 0176 5550 1234. See you Monday at 11 AM.
